name: rotate in a plane to zero the largest off-diagonal entry, repeatedly
mechanism: pick the largest off-diagonal element of a symmetric matrix, apply the plane rotation that makes it zero (touching only its two rows and columns), and repeat; the sum of squared off-diagonals falls every step and the diagonal converges to the eigenvalues
